name: statements_per_journal
note: account.bank.statement (addons/account/models/account_bank_statement.py): statements per journal with the count carrying a first_line_index, as the journal dashboard SQL groups them
source_sql: SELECT journal_id, count(*) AS statements, count(first_line_index) AS indexed FROM account_bank_statement GROUP BY journal_id ORDER BY journal_id

name: attachments_per_statement
note: account.bank.statement.attachment_ids many2many (account_bank_statement_ir_attachment_rel) embedded as accountBankStatement.irAttachmentRel: attachments per statement; statements without attachments excluded on both sides
source_sql: SELECT account_bank_statement_id AS statement_id, count(*) AS attachments FROM account_bank_statement_ir_attachment_rel GROUP BY account_bank_statement_id ORDER BY account_bank_statement_id
